discovery.title: Worsening El Nino threatens Asia with drought, potentially raising food prices globally
discovery.summary: All signs are pointing toward a record-breaking El Niño this year, which experts say may cause severe drought in Asia and other extreme weather across the world, threatening food security for millions of people.
